name: Posaconazole
executiveSummary: Broad-spectrum triazole. Adult IV/DR tablets: load **300 mg every 12 h on day 1**, then **300 mg every 24 h**. Oral suspension: different regimen — **do not interchange** formulations. TDM advisable.
indications:
## Indications

- IFI prophylaxis in prolonged neutropenia (AML/MDS) and GVHD after HSCT.
- Treatment of aspergillosis and other mycoses when voriconazole/AmB are unsuitable; selected oropharyngeal candidiasis.

## Precautions

- Strong CYP3A4 interactions (tacrolimus, sirolimus, vinca alkaloids, etc.).
- IV: **0.22 µm** filter, prefer central line; dilute to **1–2 mg/mL**.
- DR tablets ≠ oral suspension (different bioavailability).

> Trough targets (orientative): prophylaxis ≥700 ng/mL; treatment ~1000–1500 ng/mL (center-specific).

adulto.presentation: IV 300 mg/16.7 mL (18 mg/mL); DR tablets 100 mg; suspension 40 mg/mL.
adulto.dose: IV or DR tablets (≥40 kg): load **300 mg every 12 h × 2 doses (day 1)**, maintenance **300 mg every 24 h**. Suspension (not interchangeable): e.g. prophylaxis **200 mg every 8 h**; treatment per label (often **400 mg every 12 h** with food).
adulto.administration: IV: dilute 300 mg in 150–250 mL NS/D5W/LR; **90 min** with 0.22 µm filter. DR tablets with/without food. Suspension **with food** or supplement.
adulto.notes: Do not split DR tablets. Monitor electrolytes and interactions.

pediatrico.presentation: DR tablets 100 mg; suspension 40 mg/mL; IV if available.
pediatrico.dose: Suspension prophylaxis: **4–6 mg/kg every 8 h** (max **400 mg**/dose); treatment: **4–6 mg/kg every 6 h**. DR tablets ≥3 years: load **5–7 mg/kg every 12 h** (max **300 mg**) for 24 h, then **5–7 mg/kg every 24 h** (max **300 mg**). Adjust by TDM.
pediatrico.notes: ID + levels. Inducers/antacids may ↓ suspension absorption.

stability:
## Stability

- Diluted IV: ~12 h room temp / ~24 h refrigerated (label).
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Nausea, diarrhea, ↑ liver enzymes, hypokalemia, headache, rash, fever, neutropenia.
